positions.commentary: Charlie Munger says it's not a cinch today, unlike 20 years ago when Buffett and Munger thought it was.
Pabrai believes Costco is a cinch because it is hard to imagine forces destroying it today.
A friend of Pabrai's worked at a fund and analyzed American Tower, noting the CEO had his feet on his desk.
Pabrai mentions Yahoo's trailing multiple for Costco is 36, which is not bad for a kick-ass business.

thesis: This episode contrasts the investment views of Charlie Munger and Mohnish Pabrai regarding specific companies. It suggests that while Munger finds American Express difficult to value today, Pabrai views Costco as a strong, durable business. The discussion also touches on management quality and trailing multiples for other entities like American Tower and Google.

claims.claim: Charlie Munger says it's not a cinch today, unlike 20 years ago when Buffett and Munger thought it was.
claims.quote: And many times when I see him, he will say XYZ company is a cinch or ABC company is not a cinch. And like, for example, you know, if you asked him about American Express, for example, Charlie would say, it's not a cinch. But if you you had asked Buffett and Munger about American Express maybe 20 years ago, they would have said it's a cinch.

claims.claim: Pabrai believes Costco is a cinch because it is hard to imagine forces destroying it today.
claims.quote: I haven't asked Charlie this, but if I were to ask him, Charlie, is Costco a cinch? He would probably say, yes, Costco is a cinch, okay? Because it's very hard to imagine forces that would destroy Costco today.

claims.claim: A friend of Pabrai's worked at a fund and analyzed American Tower, noting the CEO had his feet on his desk.
claims.quote: And many years ago, maybe this must be more than 10, 10, 15 years ago. He was the analyst looking at American Tower, the company. And the company had organized a fuel analyst at these large firms to visit their headquarters.

claims.claim: Pabrai mentions Yahoo's trailing multiple for Costco is 36, which is not bad for a kick-ass business.
claims.quote: Let's look at what God Google says Costco's trailing multiple is right now. So the trailing multiple according to Yahoo is 36. 36. 36 is not bad for a kick-ass business like Costco.
